ionization_ratio.doc: Ionisation coefficient ratio k; lower is quieter

ignore_edges.doc: Symbols to discard at each end of the window (circular-filter wrap)

adaptive_timing.doc: Choose the sampling instant that maximises Q

sample_offset.doc: Sampling instant within the symbol when timing is fixed

linewidth.doc: Lorentzian FWHM linewidth; 0 disables phase noise

insertion_loss.doc: Insertion loss applied to every input

max_output_power.doc: Output power clamp; the gain is reduced to hold it

bandwidth.doc: Optical bandwidth over which ASE is emitted

dispersion.doc: Dispersion parameter D at the band wavelength (0 disables)

nonlinearity.doc: Kerr coefficient gamma (0 disables, and is exact)

max_nonlinear_phase.doc: Largest nonlinear phase rotation allowed per split-step [rad]

pmd_sections.doc: Waveplates used to build the PMD realisation

chirp.doc: Linear chirp parameter C; sign matters against beta2

v_pi.doc: Voltage for a pi phase shift (drive to null)

v_bias.doc: DC bias added to the drive voltage

reference_bandwidth.doc: Reference bandwidth; 12.5 GHz is 0.1 nm at 1550 nm
